Mistral's models: chat, code completion, embeddings, moderation, OCR, speech.

## API key

1. Sign in to the [Mistral console](https://console.mistral.ai).
2. Pick a plan under **Billing**: the free plan needs no card but has low limits.
3. Open **API Keys**, select **Create new key**, and give it an expiry date you'll remember.
4. Copy the key. It's shown once.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add mistral
```

To make it the model provider apps get by default:

```bash
everyapp ai default mistral
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
providers: ["mistral"],
```

The app calls `/api/ai/mistral/…` with `createGatewayFetch()`. More in [AI](/docs/agent/ai).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp ai list` shows `mistral` with its key set.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Mistral%20AI).
